verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OpenClaw is a self-hosted gateway that stores memory as local Markdown files and routes requests to user-chosen LLM providers. None of the evidence documents a training opt-out, a no-training guarantee, or any control that stops prompts or data from being used for model training. Self-hosting, local storage, and one user's own setup with local models are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not the product's own capability for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
